theme_strategy: Dark Mode Only - Tactical Command Center

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data, IP addresses, tenant IDs, logs, and statuses.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Data labels must be uppercase and tracked out.
Always use proper tracking for headings (tracking-tight).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse styles with 1px border-white/10 on edges. No soft shadows. Use sharp edges or max 2px border radius.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use 'Tracing Beam' effect for active migration job cards to show data is moving. Add terminal scanline overlays on the live job logs panel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Solid 1px strokes. No gradients on borders.

component_guidelines.header: Solid surface `bg-[#050505]` with 1px bottom border `border-white/10`. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for header, sticky elements, dropdowns, or modals.
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless or completely flat rectangular surfaces. Override Shadcn Card to have `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`, `bg-[#121212]`, and `border-white/10`. Inside, dense padding `p-6`.
component_guidelines.tables: Crucial for service modules (Exchange, SharePoint). Dense row height, sticky header. Map source to destination in two columns separated by an arrow icon. Use font-mono for item IDs.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary: `bg-[#00E5FF] text-black hover:bg-[#00B3CC]`. Secondary: `bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5`.
component_guidelines.progress_bars: 1px or 2px height. No rounded thick bars. Represent data transfer with sharp, glowing lines.
component_guidelines.badges: Minimalist. `border border-{status}/30 text-{status} bg-{status}/10 rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono`.
component_guidelines.tabs: Underline style only. Active tab gets a primary color bottom border, inactive tabs remain muted text. No pill-shaped tabs.
component_guidelines.inputs: Flat, `bg-[#0A0A0A]`, 1px border, square corners. Focus state: `focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]`.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Top row: 4 summary metrics (col-span-1). Middle row: Active Jobs (col-span-3), Log Feed (col-span-1 row-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.service_module_layout: Split pane. Left: Hierarchy tree of tenants/users (w-64). Right: Main data table with discoverable items and mapping controls.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense internally within tables/cards (`p-3` to `p-4`), but maintain clear structural gaps (`gap-4`, `gap-6`) between major grid sections.

motion.micro_interactions: Instant, snappy transitions. Hover states should feel like hardware toggles, not soft software fades.
motion.loaders: ASCII spinners or sharp geometric pulsing lines instead of circular material loaders. Represent data migration actively.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA adherence. Ensure #A1A1AA text is readable against #121212. All interactive elements MUST have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-[#00E5FF]`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="start-migration-btn"`).

media_and_icons.icon_style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly technical. Use icons for status, tenant mapping (Source -> Destination), and service types (Mail, Drive, Users).

image_urls.description: Close-up of server racks in a dark data center. Use as a highly opaque background (opacity-20) for the Admin Login screen.
IT Admin user avatar for the top right dashboard profile dropdown.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST build an ultra-clean, high-contrast dark mode dashboard. Do not use generic 'SaaS Blue' or soft shadows.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Create depth through 1px borders and slight background color shifts (from #050505 to #121212 to #1A1A1A), NOT shadows.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Cards, Tables, Buttons, Inputs) have their border-radius overridden to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` for a sharp, technical enterprise look.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography to match the technical density.
For the job queue and logs, design it like a real developer terminal (font-mono, dense, distinct status colors).
Use sonner for toast notifications, located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
Always apply `data-testid` to buttons, links, and forms.
Share the guideline for .jsx and .js files not for .tsx files as the workspace uses javascript.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in header, overlays, dropdowns, or modals.
